scan_summary.scope: Measured component benchmark: complete CBOR structural traversal and optional Blake2b-256 transaction-body hashing of a real recent Conway immutable chunk. Not a full migration benchmark.
scan_summary.framing: All 8,524,491 bytes consumed as 1,062 concatenated Conway hard-fork blocks; each has a pair wrapper with era tag 7 and five block components.
exclusions: Cold disk I/O: the chunk was downloaded and extracted immediately before the benchmark; time reports zero filesystem reads.
Ledger value decoding and exact minUTxO calculation.
Target live-UTxO lookup and metadata writes.
Historical parameter recovery and output-creation validity processing.
Representativeness across older eras, large scripts, and different asset distributions.

prebabbage_count_estimate.method: Simple random sample of 200 distinct block heights across Shelley through Alonzo; enumerate every output and check current spent status. Multiply mean surviving outputs/block by total blocks.
prebabbage_count_estimate.scope: Shelley, Allegra, Mary, Alonzo creation eras; excludes Byron and outputs created from Babbage onward. Estimates output count, not wallets or ADA. Counts queried at slightly different times, not one atomic snapshot.
